{{Quote|You're not the registered owner of this vehicle.''"<br />"''Yes, thank you, I know that. ''[&hellip;]'' It belongs to my friend Carolle. Go ahead and call her&mdash;she'll tell you she let me borrow it.|A palace guard corps lieutenant and Emperor's Hand Mara Jade|<ref name="Choices" />}}
'''Carolle''' was a fictitious [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] claimed was a friend of hers after [[Thief/Legends|stealing]] a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]]<ref name="Choices" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Carolle was mentioned in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
